thread:
anya: Hey team starting day 2 — where are the official Notion templates (runbook, 1:1, onboarding checklist)? I can view them but the Duplicate option is greyed out.
devex-bot: Quick checklist: 1) are you in the Redwood workspace? 2) is the page a DB template vs standalone? 3) do you have only 'Can view'? If so request access from page owner.
anya: I'm definitely in the workspace. On desktop the page loads but Duplicate is disabled. I don't see an owner field either.
rachel: Welcome Anya! Two common causes: (A) it's a database template — you must go to the DB and click New -> choose the template, or (B) the master page is locked/view-only. Which template specifically?
anya: Incident runbook and the '1:1 + goals' starter.
tom: Incident runbooks live in Company Home > Eng > Runbooks (database). For that one use: open Runbooks DB -> New -> select "Incident runbook (template)". The 1:1 is under People Ops > Templates as a standalone page.
people-ops: @anya I just checked the 1:1 starter 4cc it was set to Can view for new accounts by mistake. I've given you Can edit and briefly unlocked it. Refresh Notion and try Duplicate.
anya: Refreshing now... Duplicate is there, yay :tada:
anya: One follow-up: where should I move my duplicated runbook so eng-oncall can find it?
rachel: Good question. Best practice: operational runbooks go in Company Home > Eng > eng-runbooks (shared with eng-oncall). Personal notes / 1:1s live in My Workspace or People Ops > Personal > 1:1s.
anya: How do we track doc ownership so I know who to ping for updates?
tom: We use two things: 1) the Owner property in the page header (hover near the title), and 2) a small doc-meta block at the top of team docs with lines: Owner: <name>, Last updated: <date>, Contact: <slack>. If Owner is empty, ping the owning channel.
infra-bot: Pro tip: add a one-liner in the doc explaining "How to duplicate" e.g.,
```
If this is a DB template: open target DB -> New -> choose template.
If this is a standalone page:  -> Duplicate -> move to your space.
```
anya: Great, I'll duplicate the runbook into eng-runbooks and keep my 1:1 private. I'll also add the doc-meta header with Owner and contact.
people-ops: If you ever can't find the owner, drop the page link here or ping #devex and we'll assign an owner and backup. Also FYI mobile hides some controls; use desktop for duplication and page history.
anya: Thanks everyone 44b I'll share links once moved in case perms need a tweak.
rachel: Welcome aboard Anya! Ping us for any Notion weirdness.
